title: Trees Burned Black by the Hiroshima Bomb Bloomed Again

scenes.text: Trees burned by the Hiroshima bomb bloomed again the next spring.
Ginkgo trees stood within about a mile and a half of the blast.
The fireball burned off their leaves and scorched their bark.
But living cells under the bark survived, and the roots kept feeding them.
About 170 survivor trees still stand in Hiroshima today.

description:

Have you ever seen a tree like this?
